title: GHSA-chp3-j5qr-2vfr: effect platform 0.71.7 ships in 25 images and the pre-push hook refuses every Blockchain/Dev push
description:
**BLUF:** The advisory GHSA-chp3-j5qr-2vfr (CVE-2026-115779, moderate, published 2026-11-10T15:57:32Z) covers the `@effect/platform` makeCookie cookie-attribute injection, first patched in 0.97.1. The platform ships 0.71.7 as a production dependency, and the pre-push hook refuses every push that touches `Blockchain/Dev` at legs 6 and 7 until the advisory is baselined or fixed. This ticket tracks the override or upstream fix only; the decision whether to accept the advisory in the audit baseline is Kam's card `secuura-ghsa-chp3-effect-platform-shipped-1111`, still unruled when this was filed, and is not argued here. Priority Medium (3): the advisory is moderate and it blocks every push to this tree.

## What was measured

* Seat R 95th, 2026-11-11: row 13's push was refused with `PREFLIGHT FAILED on leg(s) 6 7 (13/16 legs ran)`; the advisory is not in the audit baseline under `Blockchain/Dev/scripts/audit`, and hook legs 6 and 7 read the LIVE advisory list, so any new advisory refuses every push until it is triaged.
* The package is SHIPPED: a production dependency of `@lucid-evolution/lucid` in `packages/shared` and `services/anchoring`, copied into 25 service images (R 95th's measurement).
* Source record: `/Volumes/DevMASTER/!CODING/Secuura/Blockchain/5_Project_History/2026-11-11_seatR-95th/HANDOVER.md` (the blocker paragraph and Finding 1).

## What this ticket tracks

* An overrides entry that moves the package to 0.97.1, or an upstream lucid release that does, gated on the whole platform (anchoring and the 25 images), not on the hook alone.
* Nothing is written to the audit baseline by this ticket.

## Not known

* Whether lucid works with 0.97.1 (an overrides entry is a major jump from 0.71.7).
* Whether makeCookie is reachable from any code path the platform runs.

## Searched

Searched `GHSA-chp3-j5qr-2vfr`, `@effect/platform` and `makeCookie` over title, description and comments (archived included; positive control `msgpackr` hits KS-1379, a random token 0): 0 open hits that cover this (KS-1216 matches `@effect/platform` only in passing and concerns bundled js-yaml copies).

nodes.title: Refs KS-2164: accept GHSA-chp3-j5qr-2vfr (effect platform 0.71.7) in the audit baseline until the shared re-triage date 2027-02-28

nodes.body:
**BLUF:** PR 2171 (head `be5d7b6057cd`, one commit on develop `6911aa643db1`) adds ONE reasoned baseline entry for GHSA-chp3-j5qr-2vfr (effect platform 0.71.7) to the audit baseline until 2027-02-28, on Kam's ruling of 2026-11-11 16:29:47 AEDT (card secuura-ghsa-chp3-effect-platform-shipped-1111, choice a). Config only, one JSON file (+7 -0), zero product bytes; it is ready for its gate (tier 2). Nothing is merged or deployed, and this ticket stays open: the override or an upstream lucid release is still to do (the PR says Refs).

- **Measured by this seat:** `npm run audit:gate` and `audit:locks` exit 1 on develop and name only this advisory; with the entry both exit 0 ("5 distinct advisories reported, 5 baselined"); `audit:contract` 62 of 62; with the entry's expires set to a past date both exit 1 again (restored by sha256). The pre-push hook's own legs 6 and 7 on this branch are quoted in the PR body.
- **Not measured:** no image built or opened; no override tried; no dynamic-call analysis (a text search cannot exclude one). A second fuse is named in the PR: the standalone-lock leg declares one lock out of scope until 2027-01-01 under another ticket, so that leg can go red before this entry expires for a reason that is not this entry.
